summaries.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of July 2025 as National Sarcoma Awareness Month. Sarcoma is a cancer of connective tissues, such as nerves, muscles, joints, fat, bones, and blood vessels.

title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of July 2025 as "National Sarcoma Awareness Month".
